title: scenarios fixture: `builds/travel_expense.provenance.json` `cardSha256` is stale after #36320 (card `a8a67be3…`, provenance `29162eef…`)
body:
eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Found by the daily MCP ask round, fixture day 4 (record filed today).

- **The card moved twice since the fixture's provenance was last right:**
  - #36065 (`09f0a8c2`) changed `docs/qa/scenarios/travel_expense.json` to `29162eef…`, and refreshed the provenance in the same commit.
  - #36320 (`bd22740e`) changed one seed date (`as_118_2.decided_on`, 2026-11-02 → 2026-10-31). That moved the card to `a8a67be363e9f0941b9998ae609ae37626d61f07cde87fd8a26f5fa36851af2f`, and it did not refresh `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json`.
- **Effect today:** none on the reading. The runner does not read `cardSha256`, ask mode does not use the build prompt, and the seed loaded 757/757. But every daily record from now on reports a provenance that names a card the fixture is not graded on.
- **Fix:** refresh `cardSha256` by PR, because fixtures change only by PR (`scenario-eval` §5). Optionally, have the loader or `summary` warn when a template's provenance `cardSha256` differs from the card it runs against, so the next card edit cannot leave it stale.
